items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I stayed with that band three years... Had Sidney on trumpet... And we had myself, I was on drums.

ctx.x: You started out beating on things.

I started beating on boxes with sticks. And I got my first set of drums when I was about 20 years old. And so from then on I started playing with different bands. Sidney Desvigny, they're one of the finest bands in the city. I stayed with that band three years.
Did you take any lessons from anybody or just pick it up yourself? Never to take lessons. Just play it for myself.
